book.name: Tasalonika Nǝ Mǝthlǝu
book.title: Cama Tsǝtsǝfǝ Nǝ Bulusu Nǝ Mǝthlǝu Anǝ Njir Tasalonika

content: Bulusu Wu Yiwu Nja Kǝdi Hyal Anǝ Nda
Wu jomǝya nyi, wazha ama, ˈya vǝr kǝdi aga hya kǝdi Hyal anǝ ˈya. Hya kǝdi Hyal aga ndǝshigu nǝ Thlagǝu a tǝtǝlnakǝr kusakusa, ǝnga aga ja ɗa ǝnga kadakadarkur, ǝnggǝr kǝra ji shili anǝ hyi.
Ənga tsu hya kǝdi Hyal, aga nja kǝtiya ˈya ara nji ɗǝmwaˈyu ǝnga nji shishi, ara aˈyi kalar nji ngǝ ǝnga mbǝrsa mai.
Ama Thlagǝ ndǝ tsaˈa miya ɗǝfu ngau, ju nda nǝ hyi dǝnama, ǝnga ja kǝtiya hyi ara nji ɗǝmwaˈyu.
A mbǝrsar ˈya ǝnga Thlagǝu abǝr hya vǝr mǝl sǝra ˈyi na aga hya mǝl, ǝnga tsu hya dumwa ǝnga mǝl nda.
Bǝgǝ Thlagǝu ja tsǝkwar ɗǝfuwa hyi aga hya sǝnbiya yiwukur nǝ Hyal, ǝnga sǝsǝu sǝ lagur Kǝrsiti.
Mǝl Thlǝr Sǝ Mǝnahǝ Ngau
Wazha ama, ˈya vǝr na anǝ hyi wu thlǝmǝr Thlagǝr mǝn Yesu Kǝrsiti, abǝr hya tǝkǝ ǝnga kalar zamǝ haɗǝwa, ǝnga naja aˈyi wu yiwu mǝl thlǝr ǝnga sǝra hyi highiɓǝri ara ˈya mai.
Nahyi ǝnga kǝrhyi, a sǝn hyi ǝnggǝr kǝra kikyau hya faˈabiya hiya sǝra ˈyi mǝl. Wu pǝcira ˈya ǝgya hyi na ˈya aˈyi nggya dzafǝ mai.
Ənga tsu naˈya aˈyi wu sǝm sǝr sǝm nji gǝra kina mai. Ama a sar ˈya ɓwaɓwatǝ vuˈyi ǝnga puci a vǝr mǝl thlǝr, aga ˈya sara ɗa sǝ tǝdǝɓǝ anǝ hyi.
Sǝra ɗa ˈyi mǝl abangau, ara aˈyi ˈya gǝra dǝnama nǝ yiwa aga hya dlǝwar ˈya mai, ama aga ˈya ɗa sǝr fǝ li kǝra hyu faˈabiya hiya nyi.
Wu pǝcira mǝn ar vira zǝmǝu, a nar hyir ˈya abǝr ma ndǝ nggǝl ara mǝl thlǝr, a sara nja lǝ sǝr sǝm anǝ nyi mai.
ˈYi na abangǝ ara ˈyi nggari abǝr alenyi nji wu hyi, nji haɗǝwa ngau, thlǝr mǝl aˈyi ara nda mai, kǝl nggya aga jiɓa njir mǝl thlǝr.
Culi najaka nji ˈya vǝr tǝɗǝ himiya nda ǝnga nǝ nda sǝr ɓǝla wu dǝnama nǝ Thlagǝ Yesu Kǝrsiti aga nda mǝliya kǝrnda, nda mǝl thlǝr aga nda uya ɗǝfǝ kǝra nda sǝm.
Nahyi tsu, wazha ama, a sara hya hǝɗa ǝnga mǝl sǝra tsaˈa mai.
Kalar ndǝra nggǝl ara nu sǝra ˈyi nana a gwar cama tsǝtsǝfǝ kau, hya fǝr li mǝnahǝu ar ja. A sara hya daɓǝr kǝr ǝnga ja mai, aga ja gu sǝli.
Ama a sara hya fiya nyi ar viya dawa mai, ama hya tǝɗǝ himiya ja ar viya zǝr ama.
Fǝ Barka
Bǝgǝ Thlagǝ ǝnga kǝrnyi ndǝr lǝ huɗǝ pǝrtǝu, ja nǝ hyi huɗǝ pǝrtǝ cumu wu kalar lagu. Bǝgǝ Thlagǝ ja nggya ǝnga hyi patǝu.
Nayi Bulusu ngǝ tsǝfǝ najaka usa dzau ǝnga tsa yau. Kǝ ngǝ sakida nǝ kalar cama tsǝtsǝfǝ ɗa. Ənggǝr kǝ nga yu tsǝfau.
Bǝgǝ mayiwakur nǝ Thlagǝr mǝn Yesu Kǝrsiti ja nggya ǝnga hyi patǝu. Amina.
